author: Xuph
body:
Apache by Xuph 
Helped by DaFrozenBlaze



This map is made for the dev_revs' CTW map contest.

Map features:

- Red vs Blue
-  1 Wool room above spawn
- Spawner in middle that gives you 5 seconds of: haste 1, regen 1, and speed 1 to make mid valuable for control (spawner is unbreakable)
- 12 Iron blocks per team
- 1 Golden apple and 2 iron ingots per kill

I think this map would work better for public as it was designed for that, but you could always try and scrim on it.

Loadout:



Screenshots (normal): http://imgur.com/a/z8K69

Screenshots (shaders): http://imgur.com/a/CfAYv

XML (thanks to Fouled): https://pastebin.com/19ytx2SS

Download (thanks to Mehrp): http://www.mediafire.com/file/u75c812sg58saat/Apache_CTW.rar

Feedback is appreciated.
